messages:
Anita: Noticed a batch of accounts where onboarding shows complete in Gainsight but HubSpot still lists onboarding_status=stalled. Can we build a rescue sync?
Jamal: Ugh, yep. We had a handful last month where events never made it through the playbook webhook. Renewal owners were surprised.
Devon: Root cause seems to be transient timeouts on the webhook endpoint + missing idempotency for the final event. I can add a persistent queue and idempotency key to the payload.
Lia: sync-bot showed 5x 408s on 04/05 and then events got dropped. Our current retry window is too short.
sync-bot: [warning] playbook-webhook -> hubspot-sync: repeated timeouts (5).
Anita: Plan idea: two-pronged approach: 1) extend retries + durable queue for live delivery; 2) one-off "rescue" recon job that compares Gainsight playbook state -> CRM and optionally applies the scoring change.
Jamal: Agree. For the rescue job, we should include a metadata tag like reconciled_by=rescue_sync_v1 and capture who approved it. Also allow a dry-run output for audit.
Devon: Implementation details: endpoint POST /admin/rescue-sync accepts {account_ids, dry_run, contested_override}. For contested_override=true, the job will attach a review ticket instead of mutating score.
Lia: Can we pull the scoring deltas from the canonical scoring table instead of duplicating logic? We have a SQL view scoring_rules.active_version.
Devon: Good call. I'll read from scoring_rules.active_version and apply deltas in the same order playbooks run. Example mapping looks like:
```nsetup_call_done: +12
training_complete: +18
first_value_reported: +10
enablement_signoff: +30
```
Also subtract inactivity_penalty: -20 if last_activity_days > 60.
Anita: QA: run a batch of 15 accounts in staging, include contested=true for a couple, and ensure audit logs contain old_score/new_score/trigger_event/reconciled_by.
Jamal: Add a filter to skip accounts with tag "manual_review" or customer segment "enterprise-high-touch" so we don't auto-change scores for VIPs.
Devon: I'll add skip_tags = ["manual_review", "legal_hold"] and skip_segments = ["enterprise-high-touch"]. Also will emit events to event-stream for downstream analytics.
Lia: I'll bump retry policy to 10 attempts with exponential backoff and enable dead-letter queue to surface permanently failed deliveries.
sync-bot: [info] retry_policy updated: attempts=10, backoff=exp(1.6). Updated by Lia.
Anita: Ops request: include a `contested` checkbox on the CS console so reps can opt-out of auto-reconciles for a given account. If checked, the rescue job should create a task instead of applying the delta.
Devon: Will add contested boolean and create a task in our task tracker with link to audit payload. Also, reconcile API will return a structured result with counts: {applied, skipped, contested, errors} in the response for the dry-run and real run.
Jamal: I'll prep a short dashboard widget for renewals that shows last 7 days reconciles and a weekly email digest for the renewal leads.
Lia: Timeline? We want this ready before QBR prep in 10 business days.
Devon: I'll own code + unit tests. PR by EOD Wednesday, staging run Thursday, signoff Friday morning.
Anita: Thanks team. Please paste PR link and the staging run summary here once done. Also tag #renewals when we flip to prod. :rocket:
